summary: Change-order created after invoice: ambiguous PO suffix causing payment hold
description:
Issue summary:
A vendor invoice for contractor services (INV-2026-0487) was submitted and validated against PO 45001-A. After validation, Procurement created a change order that introduced a new PO suffix (45001-B) to capture scope adjustments. The AP system attempted to auto-match the invoice to the original PO (45001-A) but then flagged a mismatch when the ledger posting required the updated PO suffix. This has caused the payment to be placed on hold pending manual PO reconciliation and GL code confirmation.

Impact:
- One outstanding vendor payment (~$82,400 USD) is blocked for the weekly payment run scheduled on 2026-03-12.
- Vendor has sent a reminder escalation to Accounts Payable.
- Risk of late fees and strained vendor relationship if not resolved before the next scheduled run.

Environment:
- AP system: Redwood AP v2.4 (hosted prod)
- Procurement system: Procurement Portal v1.9 (SaaS)
- Payment processor: FinPay (ACH/SEPA)

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence of events:
1) Vendor submitted invoice INV-2026-0487 referencing PO 45001-A on 2026-03-04.
2) Invoice matched to PO 45001-A and routed to approvals.
3) Procurement created change order CO-334 on 2026-03-06, which updated the formal PO suffix to 45001-B to reflect scope and budget reallocation. Change order note: "retro change for additional hours; amend PO suffix B".
4) AP attempted ledger posting on 2026-03-09; system matched line-level amounts to PO 45001-A initially, then failed final validation because the canonical PO suffix in procurement is 45001-B.
5) Payment entry placed on hold with reason code: PO_MISMATCH_SUFFIX.

Attachments/References:
- Invoice: INV-2026-0487.pdf (attached to ticket)
- Change order: CO-334.pdf (attached)
- Slack thread: #ap-escalations (link in comments)

Expected behavior:
- Invoice should either auto-resolve to the most recent PO revision/suffix when the change order is explicitly linked, or AP should surface a clear user action to reconcile the PO suffix during payment approval.

Desired immediate outcome:
- Clear reconciliation path so payment can be released in the 2026-03-12 payment run, with a documented audit trail linking the invoice, original PO, and change order.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Maya Chen (reporter): Vendor escalated this morning; vendor contact is requesting payment status. Attached invoice and CO to ticket. Requested PO/Procurement to confirm whether CO was intended to retroactively replace suffix A.

2026-03-10 11:03 - Priya Patel (Procurement): CO-334 was raised to capture 48 additional hours authorized after initial PO issuance. We intended 45001-B to supersede 45001-A for subsequent invoices, but we did not mark it as a hard replacement in the system. Procurement can mark CO-334 as replace-if-late, or confirm that AP should accept the invoice against 45001-B. Moving to Procurement action: update PO revision policy.

2026-03-10 13:45 - Liam O'Connor (AP): Investigating matching logic. AP matching rules currently require exact PO number including suffix to be present on the invoice metadata. If a CO exists, AP looks for an explicit link in procurement API; in this case the link exists but procurement returns both revisions and the AP comparator selects the earliest match by timestamp. I'm reproducing in staging to test patching the comparator.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 15:30 - Reproduced behavior in staging: when procurement API returns multiple PO revisions, AP comparator chooses the earliest active revision rather than the most recent. This is an edge case introduced by simultaneous invoice arrival and CO creation within a 72-hour window.

Logs: ap-matcher-prod.log lines 2458-2475 show match attempt for INV-2026-0487 -> candidate POs [45001-A (created 2026-02-10), 45001-B (created 2026-03-06)]. Comparator score tied on amount and vendor, timestamp tie-breaker selected earlier.\nError code surfaced: PO_MISMATCH_SUFFIX.\n

Cross-ref: see INT-246801 (stuck-approval-role-sync-failure) for previous cases where repayments were delayed due to mismatched metadata between Procurement and AP. Procurement has been notified to update the PO API to include a canonical 'current_revision' field.
proposed_workaround: Manual reconciliation by AP: temporarily update the invoice's PO field to 45001-B in the AP dashboard and rerun ledger posting. Document the change with an audit comment referencing CO-334. This will allow release in the upcoming payment run. Procurement to confirm the canonical PO revision in the procurement API to prevent recurrence.
next_steps: AP to perform manual reconciliation and attempt payment release (target: 2026-03-11 EOD).
Procurement to add 'current_revision' flag to PO API and update CO creation flow to optionally mark 'replace_previous_revision' for retroactive changes (ticket raised with Procurement engineering).
Platform/Eng to patch AP comparator to prefer the most recent active PO revision when multiple candidates are returned (PR reference above).
Finance to notify vendor of targeted payment date and record waiver if late fees applicable.
